title: Fundamentals of Generative AI
author: kff_ccclxxi
selftext:
As a Student Understanding AI is becoming essential, regardless of the field you're studying or working in.

My Classmates often ask that why your LLMs answer so differently why they're kindaa polished as compared to those of ours.The only reason worth mentioning is understanding AI/LLMs core.

We use AI more than ever, but knowing how to use it is different from understanding how it works. Building a foundation in AI fundamentals and Generative AI is the first step towards using this technology more effectively.

Last time, I completed two beginner friendly Microsoft Learn modules that helped me strengthen my understanding:

🔹 Get Started with AI Fundamentals

🔹 Introduction to Generative AI and Agents

Both take less than 40 minutes and are completely FREE!

I recommend y'all to Explore both courses through the links below:

📚 AI Fundamentals: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/get-started-ai-fundamentals/?wt.mc\_id=studentamb\_684871

📚 Generative AI: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/fundamentals-generative-ai/?wt.mc\_id=studentamb\_684871

A little time invested in understanding AI today can make a real difference tomorrow.
